title: Capacity
description: Census, admissions, discharges and acuity by unit and hour, for administrators' staffing and bed planning. Synthetic data; not for patient care.

panels.title: Census by unit
panels.description: Simulated admissions present at any time in each UTC hour, summed over facilities.

targets.sql: select hour_start as "time", unit as metric, sum(census) as census from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_unit_hourly_census where $__timeFilter(hour_start) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Census by care level
panels.description: Critical, intermediate and acute care levels from the hospital_units seed.

targets.sql: select census.hour_start as "time", units.care_level as metric, sum(census.census) as census from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_unit_hourly_census as census inner join @@ANALYTICS@@.dim_unit as units on census.unit_key = units.unit_key where $__timeFilter(census.hour_start) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Admissions and discharges per hour
panels.description: Admissions starting and discharges ending in each UTC hour.

targets.sql: select hour_start as "time", sum(admissions) as admissions, sum(discharges) as discharges from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_unit_hourly_census where $__timeFilter(hour_start) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Patients with admission NEWS2 of 5 or more
panels.description: Patients present whose admission NEWS2 was medium or high, by unit.

targets.sql: select hour_start as "time", unit as metric, sum(patients_news2_5_or_more) as patients from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_unit_hourly_census where $__timeFilter(hour_start) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Peak and mean census by unit
panels.description: Per facility unit, over the hours that held at least one admission.

targets.sql: select unit, max(census) as peak_census, avg(1.0 * census) as mean_census from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_unit_hourly_census where $__timeFilter(hour_start) group by 1 order by 1
